QuestInfo.name: [Identisk] Seeker's Doubt
QuestInfo.0: #bBaz#k has discovered something about Identisk Island's ancient god. Go talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: Baz says the ancient god's statues on Iden Island and Tisk Island could be fake. He wants you to consult with a scholar on Iden Island named #bObin#k to confirm his suspicions. Go find them.
QuestInfo.2: Apparently, the statues on Iden Island and Tisk Island were a work of the sculptor's imagination. You waited for Baz to complete his own investigation.

quest.0: Why not ask #bIden Island's scholar#k to find out more? Go and talk to Obin.
